scope: Purposive maintainer audit of eight saved empty-result documents. These are evaluation labels and follow-up hypotheses, not human publication approvals or a measured model recall rate.

cases.rationale: Concrete fuel-cell design replacement and capacity commitment; check permits and latest delivery. Company claims about rates, jobs and emissions are not measured outcomes.
Existing Milam coverage means not automatically novel. Financing and construction-management acquisition merit comparison. Page heading and release dateline disagree; preserve that ambiguity.
Utility procurement agreement is relevant historical context. Renewable procurement percentage is not hourly physical clean supply. Undated body and older targets cannot become current outcomes.

Original research abstract reports comparison against IFS and GenCast. Lead inherited chips; investigate methods and result tables. Linked paper is larger than current response cap; abstract alone cannot establish operational benefit.
Framework documentation describes components and license, not measured weather accuracy or a dated deployment. Could seed tooling coverage; an empty outcome screen is reasonable.
Sparse collection lacks complete named checkpoints, licensing and evaluation evidence. Relative timestamps and downloads should not become capability or productivity claims; follow model cards.
Biography and contact/navigation information provide no AI employment finding. Relevant author identity alone is not research evidence.

Company reports a measured concrete-mix embodied-carbon reduction and a regional supplier relationship. Verify underlying EPDs, baseline, project coverage and date. Do not equate material reduction with whole-campus emissions.
